prompt: I want to use a 2-point scale (Agree / Disagree) for all my attitude items — I've seen it in some older surveys and I think it keeps things simple. I also want to use 'select all that apply' for the product features question. My colleague says these are fine. Can you help me finalize the survey with these choices?

assertions.text: Explains the specific data-quality problem with a 2-point scale (loss of variance and/or information) rather than just saying it is not recommended
Recommends at least a 5-point scale (or item-specific alternative) with a reason
Explains the specific problem with 'select all that apply' (satisficing / early stopping / incomparable endorsement rates)
Recommends forced-choice yes/no per item as the alternative to select-all-that-apply
Does NOT simply agree to finalize the survey with the 2-point scale and SATA as the user requested
Maintains a respectful tone — argues the tradeoff without being dismissive or condescending
